decisions.reason: As a recently launched multi-model desk system in the firm’s core office range with its own webpage, it likely reflects meaningful investment and visible commitment, so management would tend to continue it.
This chair family is close to the established offer and was presented prominently, so with no clear failure signal management would be inclined to justify the launch by keeping it on the market.

Although more niche, these floor cushions build on the firm’s design-led interiors concept and were given their own page, which suggests enough commitment for management to persist at least another year.

The sofa is near the core business but received less visible web commitment than the other launches, so its drop risk is higher, yet as a fresh 2018 product management would still more likely retain it for now.
The high standing table fits the firm’s workplace and conference positioning and was presented on its own page, making continued support more likely than an early withdrawal.
Even though the rug collection is more distant from the established offer, the firm publicly framed it as a flagship direction, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal especially unlikely.
